title: Wireless Mobile Charging for Emergency Electric Vehicle Routing: A Mixed-Integer and Metaheuristic Framework for In-Motion Energy Transfer
summary: As electric vehicles (EVs) become central to decarbonization efforts, the need for uninterrupted power supply in time-critical logistics, particularly in medical transportation, poses unique challenges for power systems integration. Conventional fixed or mobile charging infrastructure requires vehicle downtime, which makes them unsuitable for nonstop operations such as organ delivery.
